correctness.rationale: Reversible uniform chain is irreducible for every positive rate. The positive Laplacian has only the constant zero eigenvector, so the integrated covariance equals its pseudoinverse quadratic form. Five exact rational evaluations exhaust all placements; ten pairwise differences factor into explicitly signed functions on the positive half-line. The three crossover roots and complete strict ranking follow from these factorizations. Standalone exact symbolic verification and an independent finite Fourier comparison replay successfully. No finite sample is used as an infinite proof.

Targeted database and literature searches found no claim determining the three algebraic crossing thresholds; publication priority remains qualified by inaccessible full text and broad possible spectral subsumption.

value.rationale: The motivating ten-state first/third-neighbor Markov network uses a two-state binary output to quantify response memory. Equal readout prevalence and stationary variance do not fix integrated covariance. The full all-pair positive-rate ranking, sharp maximizing and minimizing designs, and secondary algebraic rank reversals answer a concrete output-placement question with quantitative utility. This is a natural complete classification for the published test-network topology, not a claim about arbitrary networks or driven error.
